svg.text: JAX/XLA LLM Training Reference - AI-Hypercomputer/maxtext - Trust the compiler philosophy
MoE dropless Megablox - Splash Attention - GQA/MQA/MLA
Stacked (scan) vs unscanned ckpt - training vs inference format
Philosophy: pure Python/JAX - XLA handles fusion/parallelism - Pallas only for hot paths (attention, MoE)
Compiler-centric: high-level Python - XLA generates fused SPMD machine code
Step 1: max_utils init JAX distributed - build device mesh from ici/dcn config
Step 2: create_data_iterator - Grain/TFDS/HF batch - load Orbax ckpt if resuming
Step 4: forward + loss (incl MTP aux) + backward + Optax update on sharded pytree
Step 5: async Orbax save (stacked ckpt) + metrics/TensorBoard - loop steps
Pre-train to 50k+ chips - near-linear scaling - remat trades compute for memory
Pathways single-controller: batch (xpk) or headless (JAX_PLATFORMS=proxy) modes
Train to serve pipeline - checkpoint format conversion bridges training and deployment
Same codebase targets TPU and GPU via XLA - forkable reference for custom LLM development
Cloud TPU v4/v5/v6 + NVIDIA GPU - GKE XPK - 50944-chip runs - foundation of JAX AI stack pre-training
Init path: base.yml + overrides - mesh init - model load/convert - jit compile train_step - data iterator start
Step path: batch fetch - jit train_step - metrics log - async ckpt - repeat - export for decode/JetStream/vLLM
